verses.text: My son, pay attention to my wisdom; incline your ear to my insight,

xrefs.text: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise— apply your mind to my knowledge—
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.text: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.

xrefs.text: True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the hearts of fools.
The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
Your lips, my bride, drip sweetness like the honeycomb; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the aroma of Lebanon.
You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.

verses.text: Though the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey and her speech is smoother than oil,

xrefs.text: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words
to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
With her great persuasion she entices him; with her flattering lips she lures him.
His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.

verses.text: in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a double-edged sword.

xrefs.text: And I find more bitter than death the woman who is a snare, whose heart is a net, and whose hands are chains. The man who pleases God escapes her, but the sinner is ensnared.
His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

verses.text: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.

xrefs.text: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.

verses.text: She does not consider the path of life; she does not know that her ways are unstable.

xrefs.text: Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the LORD, and the LORD examines all his paths.
I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
A worthless person, a wicked man, walks with a perverse mouth,

verses.text: So now, my sons, listen to me, and do not turn aside from the words of my mouth.

xrefs.text: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise— apply your mind to my knowledge—
Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.

See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?

verses.text: Keep your path far from her; do not go near the door of her house,

xrefs.text: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
Avoid it; do not travel on it. Turn from it and pass on by.
Can a man embrace fire and his clothes not be burned?

verses.text: lest you concede your vigor to others, and your years to one who is cruel;

xrefs.text: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin in matters like this? There was not a king like him among many nations, and he was loved by his God, who made him king over all Israel— yet foreign women drew him into sin.

They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant. And so your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.
And having lulled him to sleep on her lap, she called a man to shave off the seven braids of his head. In this way she began to subdue him, and his strength left him.
“Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”

verses.text: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich the house of a foreigner.

xrefs.text: He will not be appeased by any ransom, or persuaded by lavish gifts.
Foreigners consume his strength, but he does not notice. Even his hair is streaked with gray, but he does not know.
Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings.
But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!

verses.text: At the end of your life you will groan when your flesh and your body are spent,

xrefs.text: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.
But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.

verses.text: and you will say, “How I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!

xrefs.text: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
“How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
A fool rejects his father’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction is prudent.

verses.text: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers or incline my ear to my mentors.

xrefs.text: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.

verses.text: I am on the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly.”

xrefs.text: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.
While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab,
to promiscuity, wine, and new wine, which take away understanding.

verses.text: Drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.

xrefs.text: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth:

verses.text: Why should your springs flow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?

xrefs.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts; He made water flow for them from the rock; He split the rock, and water gushed out.
Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.

verses.text: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.
May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth:

xrefs.text: Enjoy life with your beloved wife all the days of the fleeting life that God has given you under the sun— all your fleeting days. For this is your portion in life and in your labor under the sun.
Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.
You are a garden spring, a well of fresh water flowing down from Lebanon.
My sister, my bride, you are a garden locked up, a spring enclosed, a fountain sealed.

verses.text: A loving doe, a graceful fawn— may her breasts satisfy you always; may you be captivated by her love forever.

xrefs.text: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look, he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.
Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle grazing among the lilies.
Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
Drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.

verses.text: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress, or embrace the bosom of a stranger?

xrefs.text: that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.
to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh— women of Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon, as well as Hittite women.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it.
Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.

verses.text: For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the LORD, and the LORD examines all his paths.

xrefs.text: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds are all around them; they are before My face.

verses.text: The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.

xrefs.text: So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD— and be assured that your sin will find you out.
The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
to promiscuity, wine, and new wine, which take away understanding.

verses.text: He dies for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.

xrefs.text: But if they do not obey, then they perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
Are not their tent cords pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
The wicked man is thrown down by his own sin, but the righteous man has a refuge even in death.
